data.description: Formed in 2016, 22/7 is a digital voice actress idol group, with members chosen among 10,325 applicants by Yasushi Akimoto (known to be the producer for AKB48, Nogizaka46 (Nogizaka46) etc.) . Their debut single "僕は存在していなかった (Bokuwa sonzai shiteinakatta)” was charted #8, with a great start. In Jan 2020, all members casted as voice actresses in the original animation "22/7" .  They have released 6 singles since debut and this unique  2.5 dimensional idol group using anime visuals while performing in-person concerts have opened new doors to the idol-ing genre.

A band project consisting of Takanori Nishikawa (Vo.), Hiroshi Shibasaki (Gt.), SUNAO (Gt.), and Toshiyuki Kishi (Key. & Prog.).
Their music is characterized by a free-spirited, edgy, and hard-hitting sound that defies convention, and their band name reflects the concept of "the band of four male high school students” and their initial impulse towards music that anyone can gather.
data.name: Abingdon Boys School

data.description:
Japanese singer. At the age of 15, Aimer suddenly lost her voice due to overuse of her throat by singing, but a few years later she got a unique husky and sweet singing voice.
Aimer made her major debut with single “Rokutosei no yoru” in 2011. Later on in September 2016, she released her 4th album “daydream" which includes her representative song “Chouchou Musubi” and the album topped the iTunes album chart in Japan. In 2019, she released her 16th single “I beg you / hanabiratachinomarch / Sailing” which topped the weekly single Oricon chart for the first time in her career.
Her song ‘Zankyosanka’ for the worldwide popular anime “Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba” as its season 2 opening theme became a global hit soon after release in 2022. The song holds at #1 for the seventh week in a row on the Billboard Japan’s “JAPAN HOT 100” and set an all-time record in Billboard JAPAN history. It also topped Billboard Japan’s 2022 year-end Japan Hot 100, the comprehensive song chart that includes CD sales, streaming, and video views.
Aimer won the "64th Japan Record Award Special Award" at the end of 2022 and made her first appearance at the 73rd NHK Kohaku Uta Gassen singing ‘Zankyosanka’. The worldwide hit song was included in her 7th studio album titled “Open α Door” that came out on July 26th, 2023.
data.name: Aimer

data.description:
Aki Toyosaki (豊崎 愛生, Toyosaki Aki, born 28 October 1986) is a Japanese actress and singer. She had her first major voice acting roles in 2007, voicing Amuro Ninagawa in Kenkō Zenrakei Suieibu Umishō and Su in Shugo Chara!. She was named "Best New Actress" at the 4th Seiyu Awards in 2010 for her role as Yui Hirasawa in K-On! and Kana Nakamachi in Kanamemo, and received the "Best Lead Actress" and "Best Personality" awards at the 5th Seiyu Awards in 2011.

Her career as a musician began with her performance of the opening and ending themes of the anime series K-On! in April 2009. In the same month, she and three other voice actresses debuted as the musical group Sphere with their single "Future Stream". Later, K-On!'s ending theme was given Animation Kobe's "Best Song" award. She released her first solo single "love your life" in October 2009, and has since released two albums and eleven singles that have placed in the top 20 of Oricon's weekly charts. She was awarded "Best Musical Performance" at the 4th Seiyu Awards for her performance on the K-On! mini-album Hōkago Tea Time with four other actresses.
data.name: Aki Toyosaki

data.description:
ALI is a boundary-pushing project centered around its vocalist LEO, a multicultural artist whose roots span Japan, Spain, the UK, and the Philippines. Based in Shibuya, Tokyo, the group lives by the motto “Long Live Music,” blending the rhythms of funk, soul, jazz, and Latin music with the raw energy of hip-hop, rock, and ska to create a truly genre-crossing sound.

They first made waves with their independently released 2019 single "Wild Side," which served as the opening theme for the anime BEASTARS. Following this release, they skyrocketed to mainstream success with their first major-label track “LOST IN PARADISE feat. AKLO,” which was chosen to be the ending theme for the global hit anime JUJUTSU KAISEN. MLB star Shohei Ohtani used the song as his walk-up song during his time with the Los Angeles Angels, shining even more light on the band and their work.

In 2022, ALI contributed “NEVER SAY GOODBYE feat. Mummy-D” as the opening theme for the anime Golden Kamuy, and in 2024, their songs “Professionalism feat. Hannya” and “BEYOND feat. MaRI” were used as opening and ending themes for the anime The Fable. Most recently, in 2025, their song “CASANOVA POSSE” was chosen as the opening for the first part of the fourth season of the anime Dr. STONE.In 2026, Awich × ALI “Golden Horizon” was chosen as the theme song for Golden Kamuy (theatrical preview arc “Sapporo Beer Factory Arc”) and as the anime’s opening theme.

With a strong international presence, ALI enjoys strong international popularity, having performed across the U.S., Argentina, Brazil, and successfully completed an Asia Tour in 2025. They appear at major festivals and perform live every year in multiple countries, energizing audiences worldwide. Their performances and cross-cultural sound continue to defy conventions, break barriers, and unite fans across the globe.
data.name: ALI
